messages.author: emily.colton.100558@fernholtdairy.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the New England Chapter space. I am glad we have a dedicated place to coordinate our regional meet-ups and safety discussions.

messages.author: sanjay.bhattdixit.100797@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Thanks Iveta. We are finalizing the venue for the autumn tasting in Burlington and should have the schedule posted soon.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: The fall event notices are out. Please make sure your counter leads and affineurs know to register before the room reaches capacity.

messages.author: emily.colton.100558@fernholtdairy.example
messages.text: Given the current public health guidance, we are postponing our spring gathering. ICF staff are putting together remote training modules for members.

messages.author: sanjay.bhattdixit.100797@bluebarn.example
messages.text: The online grading courses are running smoothly. Let me know if any shops need assistance setting up accounts for their staff.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: The virtual symposium registration is open through ICF headquarters. It is not the same as meeting in Burlington, but the technical sessions look solid.

messages.author: amelia.tarleton.100487@lakemail.example
messages.text: We are seeing strong demand for washed rinds at the Brattleboro market, but milk supply remains tight heading into the colder months.

messages.author: emily.colton.100558@fernholtdairy.example
messages.text: It is wonderful to plan an in-person regional conference again. Dan and Jing are coordinating the committee for the Burlington venue.

messages.author: sanjay.bhattdixit.100797@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Exhibitor space for the October tasting is nearly full. Reach out quickly if you still need a table for your affineurs.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: We have a packed schedule of farm visits this year. Iris and Andres are hosting the Brattleboro stop next month.

messages.author: damien.lambert.102240@kestrelmoorcreamery.example
messages.text: The creamery is running at full capacity right now. Thanks to everyone who stopped by our table at the summer market.

messages.author: emily.colton.100558@fernholtdairy.example
messages.text: As we enter another busy year, please review the updated chapter guidelines for judging and technical workshops.

messages.author: sanjay.bhattdixit.100797@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Sponsorship commitments for the annual meeting are holding steady. We appreciate all the regional creameries supporting the chapter.

messages.author: emily.colton.100558@fernholtdairy.example
messages.text: With the recent cost increases across the supply chain, remind your teams that ICF offers hardship dues waivers and succession counseling.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: We are organizing a support circle for small makers navigating restructuring. Reach out directly if your creamery needs guidance.

messages.author: emily.colton.100558@fernholtdairy.example
messages.text: Conditions are stabilizing nicely this summer. ICF headquarters has released the latest draft of the modernized raw-milk aging rules for review.

messages.author: sanjay.bhattdixit.100797@bluebarn.example
messages.text: We are reviewing the new traceability standards in our next committee meeting. Expect a summary email from the chapter leaders soon.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: Our next-generation maker panel for the autumn showcase is fully booked. Thank you to everyone who stepped up to mentor new producers.
